_note: The four playable leaders (bible §6). One leads at a time; each has a battle command (leader assist, built next in M3). 'line' is what they say when picked; portraits are placeholders until the M4 trainer sprites.

callum.name: Callum
callum.field: Reads creature lore, fills bestiary entries, spots rares.
callum.line: Right. Gotta seal 'em all. I'm keeping a spreadsheet.

nolan.name: Nolan
nolan.line: Someone has to be the responsible one. Again.

haydon.name: Haydon

assist.name: Taunt
assist.desc: Riles the foe up: it drops its guard.

haydon.line: Trapped in a video game? Nah that's cap.

dani.name: Dani
dani.field: Befriends anything, tanks for the group.

assist.name: Shield
assist.desc: Takes the edge off the next hit.

dani.line: I don't care about Pokémon. But okay, I play. Five minutes.
